brief: A 1990s village municipal building: a long single-storey hall of cream vertical steel siding under a grey gable roof, a lettered sign band over the glazed entrance, blue-framed windows, flower beds and a flagpole. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: Kelleys Island OH municipal building (1990s): a long one-storey steel building in cream vertical panels under a low gable, blue shutters on plain windows, a big lettered sign board, a security light; flags (US and Ohio), a gravel bed of junipers and a weeping redbud

why.note: a tiny island village builds its town hall as a cheap steel building, dressed with shutters and a sign
